item.title: US Secret Service Killed Armed Man Attempting To Breach Mar-a-Lago
item.description: U.S. Secret Service agents shot and killed an unidentified man attempting to force his way into Mar-a-Lago early Sunday morning, the agency announced.

item.title: Scott Bessent Lays Out Future Of Trump’s Tariffs, Trade Deals
item.description: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent told "Sunday Morning Futures" host Maria Bartiromo on Sunday that revenue from tariffs would not drop, despite the Supreme Court's ruling against the authority President Donald Trump’ invoked to levy his "Liberation Day" tariffs.

item.title: Trump Lauds US Hockey Gold
item.description: “I’m so proud to be an American today!”

item.title: Jamieson Greer Says Trump Still Has ‘Very Durable Tools’ For Tariffs, Trade Deals
item.description: United States Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told "This Week" guest host Martha Raddatz on Sunday that, despite a Supreme Court ruling against his invoking of one legal authority, President Donald Trump still had multiple options to levy tariffs on other countries.

item.title: Newsom: Family Will Decide Presidential Run
item.description: “… we’ll do [the] decision as a family.”

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Tony Gonzales’s Support Crumbling Amid Alleged Affair Scandal, Poll Shows
item.description: Support for Republican Texas Rep. Tony Gonzales is cratering after accusations of an affair with a former aide who later committed suicide came to light, according to a poll exclusively obtained by the Daily Caller.

item.title: TUDOR DIXON: Historic Drug Price Relief For American Families
item.description: President Donald Trump has kept more campaign promises than any chief executive in modern history. From securing the southern border to lowering the violent crime rate to cutting taxes to unleashing American energy, Trump’s first year in office was history-making in its laser-like focus on tackling America’s most pressing needs.

item.title: VIJAY JAYARAJ: EPA’s CO2 Reversal Is Welcome Opening For Developing World
item.description: On a crisp, sun-drenched afternoon in the spring of 2023, I found myself walking down Constitution Avenue in Washington, D.C., in front of the William Jefferson Clinton Building, headquarters of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).

item.title: Text Message Reportedly Reveals Motivation Of ‘Deeply Disturbed’ Armed Man Killed Attempting To Breach Mar-a-Lago
item.description: The man killed by Secret Service agents Sunday while attempting to breach President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago residence in Florida had an apparent obsession with the release of files pertaining to deceased child sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, TMZ reported.

item.title: Report: Man Responsible for Mar-a-Lago Breach ‘Fixated’ on Epstein Case
item.description: “I don’t know if you read up on the Epstein Files, but evil is real and unmistakable.”
